DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11212-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11212-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 登録住所の変更でよろしいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11212-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you changing your registered address?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11212-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11212-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 住所も変わりましたが、結婚して姓も変わりました。二つ相談したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11212-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 姓と住所の二つの変更を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11212-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: My address has changed, but I also got married and changed my surname. I'd like to ask about both.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11212-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain the two changes, surname and address. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11212-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11212-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 住所変更の用紙だけでは、名義変更の確認まで終わりません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11212-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: An address change form alone will not complete the checks for changing the account holder's name.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11212-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11212-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 新しい住所を書けば姓も一緒に変わる、ということではないんですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11212-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 住所用紙だけで済むか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11212-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: So entering my new address doesn't automatically change my surname as well.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11212-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ask whether the address form alone is enough. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11212-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11212-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: はい。名義の手続きと必要な資料を担当が確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11212-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: That's right. The person in charge will check the name change procedure and the documents required.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11212-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11212-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 旧姓と今の姓、旧住所と新住所を、このメモに分けて書きました。資料も持っています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11212-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 名義の手続きも必要だと確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11212-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: I've written my former and current surnames and old and new addresses separately in this note. I have the documents too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11212-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Confirm that a name change procedure is also required. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11212-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11212-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。確認資料を担当へお見せください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11212-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: Thank you. Please show the supporting documents to the person in charge.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11212-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11212-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: お願いします。どちらか一つだけ変更済みになるのを避けたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11212-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 旧新の情報と資料を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11212-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: Please help me with that. I want to avoid having only one of the two changes completed.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11212-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Show the old and new information and the documents. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11212-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11212-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 二つの手続きの完了状況は、それぞれご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11212-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: We will tell you separately whether each of the two procedures is complete.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11212-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11212-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 姓の登録と住所の登録を別々に確かめてから、手続きがそろったか確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11212-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 両方の登録内容を確認して進める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11212-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll check the surname registration and address registration separately, then confirm whether both procedures are complete.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11212-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Check both registered details before proceeding. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11212-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11212-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。二つの変更として受け付け、担当者が順にご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11212-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. We will accept this as two changes, and the person in charge will guide you through them in order.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11212-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11212-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 表示をご覧になっていますね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11212-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: You're looking at the label, I see.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11212-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11212-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: この数字は、一袋を全部食べた時の量ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11212-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 栄養表示の基準量を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11212-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: Are these figures for eating the whole bag?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11212-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask what quantity the nutrition information is based on. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11212-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11212-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 「三十グラム当たり」とあります。この袋は九十グラム入りです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11212-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: It says 'per 30 grams.' This bag contains 90 grams.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11212-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11212-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 一袋分ではなく、三十グラムの数字なんですね。袋にはその三回分があるんですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11212-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 一袋分と思っていたと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11212-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: So these figures are for 30 grams, not the whole bag. The bag contains three times that amount.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11212-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you thought it was for one whole bag. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11212-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11212-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: はい。内容量と表示の基準量を分けて見てください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11212-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: Yes. Please distinguish the net contents from the quantity used for the label.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11212-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11212-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 一度に袋を全部食べるつもりでしたが、今日は三十グラムだけにしたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11212-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 袋の内容量を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11212-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: I was going to eat the whole bag at once, but today I'd like just 30 grams.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11212-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Confirm the quantity in the bag. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11212-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11212-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 少量の容器の商品もあります。量を比べてお選びいただけます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11212-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: We also have products in smaller containers. You can compare the quantities before choosing.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11212-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11212-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 小さい容器の方を見ます。九十グラムの袋の数字を、そのまま一袋分と考えないようにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11212-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 食べる予定の量を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11212-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'll look at the smaller container. I'll be careful not to treat the figures on the 90-gram bag as the figures for the whole bag.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11212-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say how much you plan to eat. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11212-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11212-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: こちらは三十グラム入りです。表示の基準も容器ごとにご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11212-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: This one contains 30 grams. Please check the basis of the label on each container too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11212-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11212-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 一容器三十グラムで、表示も三十グラム当たりですね。今日はこれを一つにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11212-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 一回分の量に合わせて選ぶ。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11212-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: One container holds 30 grams, and the label is also per 30 grams. I'll take one of these today.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11212-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Choose a quantity suitable for one serving. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11212-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11212-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: はい。食べる予定の量に合う商品を選ばれましたので、レジへお持ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11212-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: Yes. You've chosen a product that fits the quantity you plan to eat, so please take it to the register.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11212-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11212-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 工事の案内でお困りですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11212-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you having trouble with the construction notice?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11212-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11212-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。この道は全部通れないと思ったのですが、歩いている人がいます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11212-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 表示を見て迷ったと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11212-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. I thought this entire road was closed, but people are walking along it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11212-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say that the sign confused you. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11212-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11212-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 工事している右側は入れません。左側の仮の道は歩行できます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11212-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: You cannot enter the right side where the work is taking place. You can walk along the temporary path on the left.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11212-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11212-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 私は自転車を押して散歩しています。左側を通ってもいいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11212-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 歩行できる区間を聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11212-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: I'm out for a walk, pushing my bicycle. May I use the left side?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11212-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ask which section is open to pedestrians. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11212-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11212-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 押して通ることはできます。乗って走るのはお控えください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11212-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: You can push it through. Please refrain from riding it.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11212-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11212-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: では、ここでも乗らずに押します。友人と横に並ぶと狭そうですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11212-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 自転車連れであると説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11212-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: Then I'll keep pushing it here too, rather than riding. It looks too narrow to walk side by side with my friend.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11212-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain that you have a bicycle with you. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11212-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11212-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: はい。対向の方がいる時は一列で、広い所で譲り合ってください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11212-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: Yes. When someone is coming the other way, please go in single file and give way in a wider spot.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11212-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11212-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 友人に先を歩いてもらい、私は自転車を押して後ろに続きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11212-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 押して通る条件を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11212-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'll have my friend walk ahead, and I'll follow behind, pushing my bicycle.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11212-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Confirm the conditions for pushing your bicycle through. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11212-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11212-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 工事の柵の中には入らず、仮の道の範囲でお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11212-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please stay on the temporary path and do not enter the area inside the construction fence.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11212-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11212-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 分かりました。左側だけを一列で進み、すれ違う時は広い所で待ちます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11212-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 狭い区間では同行者と一列になると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11212-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: Understood. We'll go single file only on the left and wait in a wider place when passing someone.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11212-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will go single file with your companion in the narrow section. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11212-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11212-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。その通り方なら大丈夫です。工事区間をゆっくりお進みください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11212-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Thank you. That way is fine. Please proceed slowly through the construction section.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11215-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11215-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: ホームへご案内しましょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11215-01-001-SHARED-01.translation: Shall I show you to the platform?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11215-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11215-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: まだ発車まで時間があります。長く立っていると腰がつらいので、座って待ちたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11215-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 長く立てないと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11215-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: There's still time before departure. My lower back hurts if I stand for long, so I'd like to sit while waiting.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11215-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that you cannot stand for long. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11215-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11215-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 改札の中の待合スペースに椅子があります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11215-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: There are chairs in the waiting area inside the ticket gates.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11215-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11215-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: そこで座ると、発車の案内も見られますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11215-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 座って待てる場所を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11215-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: Can I see the departure information while sitting there?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11215-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ask where you can sit and wait. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11215-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11215-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 表示が見えます。変更は放送でもお知らせします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11215-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: You can see the display. We also announce changes over the speakers.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11215-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11215-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 助かります。そこからホームへは、どの道で行きますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11215-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 発車案内の確認方法を聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11215-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: That helps. Which way do I go from there to the platform?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11215-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask how to check departure information. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11215-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11215-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 右の通路からエレベーターを使います。混む時間もありますので、余裕を持ってください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11215-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: Take the elevator via the passage on the right. It can get crowded, so please allow plenty of time.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11215-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11215-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: では、直前まで座り続けず、早めに表示を確認して移動します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11215-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: ホームへ移る時間を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11215-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: Then I won't remain seated until the last minute. I'll check the display and head over early.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11215-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Confirm when to move to the platform. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11215-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11215-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい。エレベーターの位置は、この図の青い印です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11215-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes. The elevator is marked in blue on this diagram.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11215-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11215-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 待合スペースで休み、ホームと時刻を確認したら青い印へ向かいます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11215-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 余裕を持って席を離れると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11215-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll rest in the waiting area, check the platform and time, then head for the blue mark.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11215-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will leave your seat with time to spare. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11215-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11215-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: どうぞ。待合スペースは奥の左側です。席を譲り合ってご利用ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11215-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please do. The waiting area is on the left at the back. Please be considerate and share the seats.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11215-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11215-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 転入の用紙で、確認したいところはありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11215-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: Is there anything on the moving-in form you'd like to check?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11215-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11215-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 引っ越した日です。契約は九月二十日からですが、実際に住み始めたのは十月一日です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11215-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 二つの日付が違うと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11215-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: It's the date I moved. My lease began on September 20, but I actually started living there on October 1.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11215-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that the two dates differ. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11215-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11215-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 契約の開始日と、実際の転居日が違うのですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11215-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: So the lease start date and the date you actually moved are different.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11215-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11215-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: はい。契約書を見て九月二十日と書きましたが、生活を始めたのは一日です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11215-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 実際の入居日を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11215-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yes. I looked at the lease and wrote September 20, but I began living there on the first.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11215-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Give the actual date you moved in. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11215-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11215-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: その経過を担当へ伝え、届の日付を確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11215-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please explain that sequence to the person in charge and confirm the date to put on the notification.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11215-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11215-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 分かりました。消しゴムで消せない用紙なので、訂正の仕方も聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11215-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 契約開始日を書いていたと示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11215-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: Understood. This form can't be corrected with an eraser, so I'd also like to ask how to correct it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11215-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Show that you entered the lease start date. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11215-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11215-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 記入済みの用紙を見せて、訂正方法の案内を受けてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11215-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: Show the completed form and ask for instructions on correcting it.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11215-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11215-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 新しい日付を上から重ねて書かず、このまま担当に見せます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11215-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 訂正方法を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11215-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'll show it to the person in charge as it is, without writing the new date over the old one.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11215-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask how to correct the form. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11215-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11215-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 契約書もあれば、二つの日付の違いを説明しやすいですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11215-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: If you have your lease too, it will be easier to explain the difference between the two dates.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11215-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11215-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 持っています。契約開始は二十日、実際の入居は一日と伝え、確認してから訂正します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11215-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 担当確認を受けて日付を直す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11215-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: I have it. I'll explain that the lease began on the twentieth and I actually moved in on the first, then make the correction after checking.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11215-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Correct the date after checking with the person in charge. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11215-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11215-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: はい。用紙と契約書を持って、住所異動の窓口へお進みください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11215-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: Yes. Please take the form and lease to the address change counter.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11215-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11215-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: ご予約の変更ですね。お名前をお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11215-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: You'd like to change a reservation. May I have your name?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11215-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11215-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 山本です。父と同じ日に予約がありますが、変更したいのは私だけです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11215-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 二人の予約があると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11215-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: It's Yamamoto. My father and I have reservations on the same day, but I only want to change mine.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11215-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say there are reservations for two people. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11215-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11215-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: お二人の予約を確認します。お父様の日時はそのままでよろしいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11215-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: I'll check both reservations. Should your father's date and time remain unchanged?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11215-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11215-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: はい。父は今の日時で来られます。私の仕事だけ都合が変わりました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11215-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 変更対象は自分だけと明確にする。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11215-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yes. My father can come at the current time. Only my work schedule has changed.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11215-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Make clear that only your reservation needs changing. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11215-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11215-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: お客様の分は、次の火曜日の午後へ変更できる候補があります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11215-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: There is an option to move your reservation to next Tuesday afternoon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11215-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11215-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: その時間なら行けます。父の予約を一緒に移す必要はないですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11215-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 父の予約を残したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11215-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: I can come then. We don't need to move my father's reservation along with mine, do we?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11215-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you want to keep your father's reservation. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11215-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11215-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 別々の予約ですので、今回はお客様の分だけ変更します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11215-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: They are separate reservations, so we'll change only yours this time.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11215-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11215-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: お願いします。変更後の私の日時と、残る父の日時を分けて確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11215-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 自分の別日候補を選ぶ。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11215-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: Please do. I'd like to check my new date and time and my father's unchanged date and time separately.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11215-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Choose an alternative date for yourself. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11215-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11215-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: お客様は火曜午後二時、お父様は元の金曜午前十時です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11215-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yours is Tuesday at 2 p.m.; your father's remains Friday at 10 a.m.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11215-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11215-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 私が火曜二時、父が金曜十時ですね。それぞれの予定表に別々に入れます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11215-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 二人の結果をそれぞれ確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11215-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: Mine is Tuesday at two, and my father's is Friday at ten. I'll put each one into our separate calendars.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11215-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm the result for each person separately. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11215-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11215-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。お客様分だけを変更し、お父様の予約は元の日時で残します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11215-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. We'll change only your reservation and leave your father's at the original date and time.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11215-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11215-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 自転車が見当たらないのですね。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11215-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11215-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。家の共用駐輪場に置いていた青い自転車がありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11215-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 自転車がなくなった場所を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11215-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: That's right. My blue bicycle is missing from the shared bicycle parking area at home.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11215-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain where the bicycle went missing. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11215-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11215-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: ご家族など、使うことがある方はいらっしゃいますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11215-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: Is there anyone, such as a family member, who sometimes uses it?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11215-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11215-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 弟が借りることがあります。母には聞きましたが、弟はまだ仕事中で連絡がついていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11215-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 家族が借りることもあると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11215-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: My younger brother sometimes borrows it. I've asked my mother, but my brother is still at work and I haven't been able to reach him.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11215-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say a family member sometimes borrows it. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11215-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11215-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: では、弟さんが使っているかは未確認なのですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11215-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: So you haven't yet confirmed whether your brother is using it.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11215-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11215-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: はい。母が知らないと言ったので、家族は誰も使っていないと言いそうになりました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11215-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 確認済みと未確認の人を分ける。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11215-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: That's right. My mother said she didn't know, so I almost said that no one in the family was using it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11215-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Distinguish whom you have and have not checked with. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11215-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11215-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 確認できていることと、まだ分からないことを分けて伺います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11215-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: We'll ask about what you have confirmed separately from what you don't yet know.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11215-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11215-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 弟にメッセージを送り、使用しているか確認します。置いた時刻と車体の写真も整理します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11215-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 未確認の家族に連絡すると決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11215-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'll message my brother to check whether he's using it. I'll also organize the time I left it there and photos of the bicycle.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11215-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Decide to contact the family member you haven't checked with. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11215-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11215-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: ご家族が使っていないと分かった場合、その結果もご相談時にお伝えください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11215-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: If you find that no family member is using it, please include that result when you consult us.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11215-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11215-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 分かりました。まず弟の返事を待ち、確認結果を添えて経過を説明します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11215-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 結果と経過を持って相談を続ける。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11215-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: Understood. I'll wait for my brother's reply first, then explain what happened along with the result of that check.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11215-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Continue the consultation with the result and sequence of events. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11215-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11215-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。今のお話では、弟さんの使用は未確認として伺いました。結果が分かりましたらお知らせください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11215-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. Based on what you've said, we have noted that your brother's use is unconfirmed. Please let us know once you find out.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11215-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11215-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: どのような方法でお送りになりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11215-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: How would you like to send this?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11215-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11215-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 提出書類です。案内に「受け取りの記録が残る方法」とあります。普通に送るだけで足りますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11215-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 提出先の記録条件を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11215-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: These are documents I need to submit. The instructions say to use 'a method that leaves a record of receipt.' Is ordinary mailing enough?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11215-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Show the recipient's requirement for a record. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11215-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11215-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 必要な記録の条件を、まず案内で確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11215-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: First, let's check the instructions for the kind of record required.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11215-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11215-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: こちらです。発送した記録だけでなく、相手が受け取った記録と書いてあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11215-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 通常発送で足りるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11215-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: Here they are. It says a record of the recipient receiving it, not just a record of sending it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11215-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ask whether ordinary mailing is enough. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11215-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11215-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: その指定に合うサービスがどれか、担当者がご説明します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11215-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: The person in charge will explain which services meet that requirement.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11215-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11215-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: お願いします。追跡番号があるだけで指定を満たすかも、確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11215-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 指定文言を一緒に確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11215-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: Please do. I'd also like to confirm whether having a tracking number alone meets the requirement.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11215-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Check the specified wording together. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11215-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11215-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 条件と料金を比較してご案内します。書類はこの封筒で完成していますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11215-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: We'll compare the conditions and fees for you. Are all your documents ready in this envelope?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11215-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11215-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: はい。中身はそろえて封をしました。この状態の料金で説明を聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11215-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 対象のサービスを説明してもらう。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11215-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes. I've gathered everything and sealed it. I'd like the fee explained for the envelope in this condition.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11215-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask for an explanation of the applicable services. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11215-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11215-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 承知しました。封筒を測り、利用できる方法をご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11215-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: Understood. We'll measure the envelope and explain the available methods.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11215-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11215-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 提出先の条件を満たすことを優先し、料金と受取記録の内容を聞いてから選びます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11215-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 費用と条件を聞いてから選ぶ。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11215-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: My priority is meeting the recipient's conditions. I'll choose after hearing the fees and what the receipt record includes.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11215-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Choose after hearing the cost and conditions. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11215-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11215-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: はい。案内の指定を確認しながら、候補のサービスを順にご説明します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11215-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: Yes. We'll explain the service options one by one while checking the requirements in your instructions.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11215-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11215-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: その申込書は、お客様ご自身のものでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11215-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: Is that application form for you yourself?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11215-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11215-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 妹の分です。日本語の説明を手伝っています。妹は今、入口で電話をしています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11215-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 記入を手伝っている立場を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11215-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: It's for my younger sister. I'm helping her with the Japanese explanation. She's on the phone by the entrance now.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11215-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that you are helping with filling out the form. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11215-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11215-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: お申し込みになる本人が記入する欄があります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11215-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: There are sections the applicant must complete herself.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11215-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11215-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 妹の名前も私が書いてよいと思っていました。署名欄まで代わりに書けますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11215-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 本人が戻る予定を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11215-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: I thought I could write my sister's name too. Can I even fill in the signature section on her behalf?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11215-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that the applicant will return. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11215-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11215-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 署名はご本人にお願いしてください。他の記入についても、担当に確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11215-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please have her sign it herself. Let's check with the person in charge about the other entries too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11215-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11215-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: では、署名は空けて、妹が戻るのを待ちます。私が申込者になるわけではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11215-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 代理記入できる範囲を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11215-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: Then I'll leave the signature blank and wait for my sister to return. I'm not becoming the applicant.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11215-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask which sections you may fill in on her behalf. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11215-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11215-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: はい。本人の確認と、申込内容の説明もご本人へ行います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11215-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: Yes. We will also verify her identity and explain the application details to her directly.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11215-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11215-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 私が翻訳を手伝う場合も、妹が内容を理解して確認する時間を取りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11215-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 署名を本人に任せると決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11215-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: Even if I help translate, I'd like to allow time for my sister to understand and check the details herself.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11215-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Decide to leave the signature to the applicant. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11215-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11215-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: そのようにご案内します。戻られたらお知らせください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11215-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: We'll arrange it that way. Please let us know when she returns.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11215-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11215-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 妹が戻ったら、空いている署名欄と記入内容を一緒に確認し、本人から提出してもらいます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11215-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 本人と確認してから提出する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11215-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: When my sister returns, we'll check the empty signature section and the entries together, then have her submit it herself.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11215-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Check with the applicant before submission. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11215-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11215-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。今は用紙をお持ちのまま、ご本人が戻られるのをお待ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11215-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. For now, please keep the form with you and wait for the applicant to return.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11215-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11215-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こちらの商品をご覧ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11215-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you looking at this product?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11215-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11215-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。一個だけ買いたいのですが、大きく書かれた百円になりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11215-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 一個の価格を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11215-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. I only want one. Will it be the 100 yen shown in large print?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11215-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask the price of one item. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11215-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11215-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 百円は、二個同時に購入した時の一個当たりの価格です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11215-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: 100 yen is the price per item when you buy two at the same time.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11215-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11215-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 札の下に「二個で二百円」とありますね。一個だけなら違う価格なんですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11215-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 大きい表示の価格を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11215-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: At the bottom of the tag it says 'two for 200 yen.' So the price is different if I buy just one.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11215-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Point out the price in large print. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11215-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11215-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 一個の場合は百三十円です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11215-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: One on its own is 130 yen.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11215-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11215-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 二個買う方が単価は安いですが、今日は一個しか使いません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11215-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 二個購入の条件を読む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11215-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: The unit price is lower if I buy two, but I only need one today.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11215-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Read the condition requiring a two-item purchase. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11215-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11215-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 必要な個数でお選びください。一個も購入できます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11215-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please choose the quantity you need. You can also buy just one.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11215-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11215-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: では、百三十円で一個にします。安い表示だけを見て、余分に買うのはやめます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11215-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 必要なのは一個だと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11215-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: Then I'll take one at 130 yen. I'll stop myself from buying extra just because I see the lower price.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11215-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you only need one. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11215-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11215-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい。一個のお会計では通常価格になります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11215-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes. A single item is charged at the regular price.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11215-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11215-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 条件を確認しました。一個をかごに入れ、レジでは百三十円かを確かめます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11215-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 通常価格で一個購入すると決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11215-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: I've checked the condition. I'll put one in my basket and confirm at the register that it's 130 yen.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11215-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Decide to buy one at the regular price. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11215-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11215-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。選ばれた一個を、そのままレジへお持ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11215-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. Please take the one you've chosen to the register.
